problem_context.problem_statement: 按用户最终方案移除公开规格中的 @pre；保持 strong_spec 数学合同不变；新增由同一 C 函数体直接验证、且不从 strong_spec 派生的 self_loop_spec。
problem_context.expected_behavior: strong_spec/member/front/tail 行为不变但直接使用未被重新赋值的参数；self_loop_spec 在 xizi_dll(node,nil) 上为 no-op。
problem_context.input_output_contract: Add independent direct self_loop_spec with Require/Ensure xizi_dll(linklist_node,nil); annotate implementation with both self_loop_spec and strong_spec; do not extend strong_spec; existing derived specs otherwise unchanged except removing @pre.
spec_hint: Use QCP multi-direct-spec pattern as in QCP_examples/QCP_demos_LLM/swap.c swap0: declare both specs and attach both names to one implementation body.
preferred_hidden_properties: 自环节点 next/prev 均指向自身，四次写入后状态不变。
forbidden_patterns: 不得扩展或弱化 strong_spec；不得把 self_loop_spec 写成 <= strong_spec；不得允许非空 sentinel；不得参考 QCP_demos_human。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
